about.bio:
Hey! I'm Sarthak, a thumbnail designer who loves turning ideas into scroll-stopping visuals.
I design YouTube thumbnails that are clean, clickable, and built to perform.

process.desc: I start by analyzing top performing thumbnails in your niche to understand what works.
I create a rough sketch to plan the layout and message.
I design the thumbnail with high-contrast visuals and clean effects for maximum clicks.
